question: Five friends live on five different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5. Sanjay lives on the floor immediately above Namrata. Anshika lives on the third floor. Heena lives on the lowermost floor. Namrata lives on the floor immediately above Anshika. Manvir lives on the floor immediately above Heena. Who lives on the topmost floor?
solution:
Given: Five friends live on five different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5.

1) Anshika lives on the third floor.

2) Heena lives on the lowermost floor.
